Hi, Alexander,

How are you?

I would like to show you a power booster that transforms 1*DC12V~DC48V
input to 2*DC52.4V output.

*It is very useful in solar power solution where most PV generated power is
between DC12V~DC24V.*

This power converter increases the voltage and make possible powering
standard PoE switches.

85*85*30mm, 0.3kg, din/wall mounted

Is it useful to you?

Thank you.
[image: power converter.jpg]
-- 

Simon/Saga Telecom

Connecting, Converting, Creating

subj: New and Improved Services on FindLight for the Photonics Industry
text:
Dear Valued FindLight Supplier,



Hope this email finds you well.



We want to notify you of some changes to the Basic (free) as well as premium service tiers on FindLight, which become effective on September 15, 2024. Over the past two yeas, we heard your voices about certain improvements in our services which many of you wanted to see. Now we delivered it. We are thankful to those of you who provided feedback, laying the foundation for these changes.



Here are the improvements in a nutshell:





Provide an option for a month-to-month payment option for all premium tiers. DONE!


Allow more product listings under the Basic (free) account. It was 10 products max, now it is 15. DONE!


Don’t limit the number of sales leads under the Basic (free) account. DONE!


Increase the number of product listings allowed under the Starter package and improve the listing assistance. DONE!


Increase premium placement of products under Best Value and Enhanced tiers. We doubled the premium placements. DONE!


Introduce à la carte marketing services to promote on FindLight. DONE!





To find the detailed description of the improved services please visit our pricing page: https://www.findlight.net/pricing.



Once again, thank you for working with us and inspiring the changes to better serve your needs.



Warm regards,


The FindLight Team
